answer: Audits are recorded in kernel, queued in zenith, and basalt publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 78 identities per epoch. A farm of 182 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1596 identities would post 4951 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
